minor.issue: test_iteration29::test_verify_rate_limit_kicks_in_after_30_calls consistently fails via public URL (45 anonymous hits, no 429 returned). PRE-EXISTING infrastructure issue — likely due to K8s ingress mapping each request to a different upstream/IP so per-IP rate-limit key doesn't accumulate. Was passing in iter-24 report but same test failed here twice in a row. Not introduced by iter-25 (no rate-limit code changed). Consider using X-Forwarded-For header for rate-limit key, or mark test @pytest.mark.skip when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to an ingress-fronted URL.

ui_bugs.issue: SyntaxError: Unexpected token — function body 'SubscriptionModal' opens at line 301 with '{' but has no closing '}' before the next 'function CreateSessionModal' declaration at line 380. rca of the issue: FRONTEND COMPILE BLOCKER RCA: LiveSessionsPage.tsx SubscriptionModal function (declared at line 301 as `function SubscriptionModal({...}) {`) never closed its function body with '}'. The `return (` at line 330 was properly closed by ')' at line 377, but the enclosing function was left open. Then at line 379 the next `function CreateSessionModal(` began — Babel parser saw the '(' as a call expression on the still-open SubscriptionModal function's return value, then choked on the '{' body opener at EOF (line 614 col 0). Fix: inserted '}' between line 377 ')' and line 378 blank. Reproduce: Before fix `curl /login` returned CRA HTML but every JS bundle failed to compile, showing the red 'Compiled with problems' overlay. After fix: /login shows login form immediately; all subsequent E2E verified. Rate-limit RCA (not iter-25): pytest hits public URL where K8s ingress fronts backend — likely per-request X-Forwarded-For is not being consulted by the rate-limit key builder, so different pod-local client IPs get separate counters.
